# Private Travel CR

> Private Travel CR provides private transportation and private drivers across Costa Rica: door-to-door airport transfers, point-to-point shuttles, and full-day tours. Every trip is a private vehicle with a professional bilingual (English–Spanish) driver — priced per vehicle, not per person. Rated 5.0 stars (200+ Google reviews), ICT-licensed, insured through INS (Costa Rica's national insurer), and TripAdvisor Travelers' Choice 2025.

- **Business:** Private Travel CR

## What we offer

- **Private transportation / private transfers:** A vehicle reserved exclusively for your group — no shared rides, no other passengers, no detours. You choose the pickup time, pickup address (any hotel, Airbnb, or location), and destination.
- **Private driver:** Every transfer includes your own professional, vetted, fully licensed, bilingual (English–Spanish) driver who knows Costa Rica's roads. Not a rideshare app or shared pool. The same driver can stay with your group for multi-day trips and full-day tours.
- **Airport pickups with flight tracking:** The driver monitors your flight in real time and waits at no extra charge if it's delayed.
- **Full-day tours and multi-day trips:** Custom itineraries with the same private driver and vehicle.

### Included in every private transfer

Modern 2024+ vehicle, door-to-door pickup and drop-off, professional bilingual driver, flight tracking on airport pickups, free child seats (infant, convertible, booster), bottled water, on-board WiFi, all taxes and tolls. No hidden fees.

## Fleet

- **Hyundai Staria** — Premium SUV, 1–5 passengers, from $90 USD
- **Toyota Hiace** — High-roof van, 6–9 passengers, from $120 USD
- **Maxus V90** — Executive van, 10–12 passengers, from $180 USD
- Groups larger than 12 passengers: contact via WhatsApp for a custom quote

All vehicles are air-conditioned, insured, and cleaned before every trip.

## Pricing

Prices are **per vehicle, not per person** — the same total cost for 1 to 5 passengers in a standard van. Private transportation starts at **$135 USD**. Popular routes (2026 rates, all taxes included):

- LIR Airport → Papagayo Peninsula — from $95 (30 min)
- LIR Airport → Tamarindo — from $135 (1 h 15 min)
- SJO Airport → La Fortuna (Arenal) — from $220 (3 h)
- SJO Airport → Manuel Antonio — from $220 (3 h)
- SJO Airport → Monteverde — from $220 (4 h)
- LIR Airport → La Fortuna — from $225 (3 h)
- La Fortuna → Monteverde — from $255 (3 h)
- SJO Airport → Tamarindo — from $345 (5 h)

Over 1,200 routes are available. Full route list and instant quotes at https://www.privatetravelcr.com/routes

## Frequently asked questions

- **How much does private transportation cost in Costa Rica?** From $135 USD per vehicle for short routes (e.g. LIR → Tamarindo) up to ~$420 USD for the longest popular routes. Most popular routes are $220–$260. Priced per vehicle, so the cost is the same for 1 to 5 passengers in a standard van.
- **Do I get a private driver?** Yes. Every private transfer includes your own professional, vetted, fully licensed, bilingual (English–Spanish) driver dedicated to your group — not a rideshare or shared pool.
- **Is it worth it vs. a shared shuttle?** Shared shuttles ($55/person) win for solo budget travelers. For groups of 3+, private transportation is usually the same total cost but 1–2 hours faster and door-to-door.
- **What if my flight is delayed?** Flight tracking is included on every airport pickup; the driver adjusts automatically at no extra charge.
- **Do you serve both airports?** Yes — SJO (San José) and LIR (Liberia, gateway to the Guanacaste beaches: Tamarindo, Papagayo, Conchal, Flamingo).
- **What is the cancellation policy?** Cancellations 48+ hours before pickup get a full refund. Within 48 hours, no-shows, and last-minute changes are non-refundable. Provider-side cancellations (weather, road closures, safety) get a full refund or free reschedule.
